script: The payment is fake, and the money you send back is your own. Stop, do not return any money, and report the client. Another pattern is a job that needs you to buy software, gift cards, or a starter kit before you begin. Real clients do not ask you to pay them. When you feel rushed, slow down. Scammers depend on speed. Good clients accept a short delay for checks. A good client will respect your process. Anyone who pushes you to skip the checks is showing you something important. Next, we look at balancing home and work, and growing your career.
